verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB exposes the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface for programmatic SQL access (docs-5, docs-29). An MCP server offers tools to list services, run SQL and read monitoring (docs-7), and CHKit provides agent-drivable typed commands for deploying schema and pipelines (docs-11). However, the evidence never shows a documented public control-plane API (REST or similar) for creating, resizing or managing clusters, alerts or users, so programmatic control is mostly limited to the data plane plus MCP and CLI surfaces. Missing for 10: a documented public management/provisioning API with reference docs, API auth/key model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
